info.title: TD.J1 Birth-dose DVC API
info.description: What the birth hospital records for each birth dose and signs into one Digital Vaccination Certificate (DVC, an HCERT) per dose: the payload, the CWT claims and the key that signs it.

get.summary: JSON Schema definition for the Logical Model StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdBirthDoseDvc
get.description: This endpoint serves the JSON Schema definition for the Logical Model StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdBirthDoseDvc.

StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdBirthDose.title: TD.J1 Birth-dose DVC
StructureDefinition-TrustDemoDdBirthDose.description: What the birth hospital records for each birth dose and signs into one Digital Vaccination Certificate (DVC, an HCERT) per dose: the payload, the CWT claims and the key that signs it.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for TrustDemoDdBirthDoseDvc logical model

@context.description: JSON-LD context for this logical model with ValueSet vocabularies

anyOf.description: URI reference to external JSON-LD context

@type.description: JSON-LD type identifier for TrustDemoDdBirthDoseDvc logical model

name.description: The child's name as the birth hospital records it.

guardianName.description: The parent or guardian, for a subject with no identity document such as a newborn (STT-PAY-005).

hospitalNumber.description: The birth hospital's own identifier for the child. It is not carried in the DVC.

vaccineProduct.description: The product given, in the issuer's product coding (illustrative PreQual-style codes).

dateOfVaccination.description: The date the dose was given. The hospital record holds the time as well; the DVC carries the date.

batchNumber.description: The batch (lot) of the vaccine given.

doseNumber.description: The dose's number in its series. Recorded by the hospital; the minimal DVC payload does not carry it.

clinician.description: The clinician who gave or supervised the dose.

issuerCountry.description: The trust-network participant whose key signs the DVC (J1: XXR).

expiresAt.description: When the DVC stops verifying, where the issuer sets an expiry.

keyId.description: Identifies the document signer certificate on the trust list that verifies the DVC (J1: 916ffa567c0f44a2).
